thread:
sre-oncall: paging: high 5xx spike at api-gateway observed, alerting oncall. Error rate jumped from ~0.1% to 23% over 3m. Affected: /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. TL;DR: partial service degradation, not global outage.

ops-bot: INCIDENT BOT: Pager triggered for channel <#incidents>. Severity: high. Pager: @pager-duty oncall. Start: 2026-03-15T02:14:48Z.

pager-duty: I'm on it, waking up. Giving initial triage window 5m. Any obvious recent deploys or config changes?

alex_m: Checking deploy history — no user-facing deploys in last 10m. There was a rolling cache invalidation for model metadata ~4m ago (shipper). Could be related.

nina_r: Telemetry: upstream edge proxies showing increased 502 and 504 at the gateway tier in eu-west-1. Error logs show a lot of `read timeout` from backend pools and `connection reset by peer`.

sre-oncall: Good. Can someone attach a quick query of 502/504 by host?

alex_m: Query results (last 10m):
```
HOST              5xx_count   200_count   5xx_ratio
edge-a-eu-west    2400        8200        22.6%
edge-b-eu-west    1100        7200        13.3%
gateway-us        80          9500        0.8%
```
Looks concentrated in edge-eu-west.

nina_r: We also see a surge in fanout to backend model managers right before the spike — simultaneous POSTs for model-config refresh from many edge processes. Likely the cache flush caused aggressive refetches.

product-ops: Customer impact: several small PLG customers reporting elevated latency and errors in EU. No billing impact yet, but UX broken for chat flows. Noticed error content: `502 Bad Gateway` and `504 Gateway Timeout` to clients.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Throttle/refuse cache-refetch requests at the edge to smooth load 2) Enable circuit breaker to mark unhealthy backend pool and route to backup model shards 3) If needed, rollback cache invalidation job. Who can apply throttling?

alex_m: I can flip a rate-limit on the edge process (config flag `edge.cache_refetch_rate_limit`) to 10 rps per host now. Applying in 3..2..1

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: edge-config update deploy started by alex_m — config: edge.cache_refetch_rate_limit=10; target: eu-west; rollout: immediate.

ops-bot: SYSTEM: Rate-limit applied on edge-a-eu-west and edge-b-eu-west. Observed inbound refetch QPS drop from 600 -> 70 over 90s.

nina_r: After rate-limit, 5xx trend is trending down but still elevated. 5xx ratio now ~9% on edge-a. Backend latencies for model-manager calls still high (p95 > 2.8s).

sre-oncall: Next: circuit breaker. Can we mark model-manager pool `mm-eu-west-1a` as degraded to stop retries/fanout? That should reduce connection thrash.

alex_m: Triggering circuit-breaker via admin API: `POST /admin/circuit-breaker/mm-eu-west-1a?action=open&ttl=300`

ops-bot: ACTION: Circuit-breaker opened for mm-eu-west-1a (ttl=300s). Routing adjusted: traffic to fallback pools mm-eu-west-1b and mm-eu-west-2a.

nina_r: Nice. Latencies dropping on mm-eu-west-1a and error rates continuing to fall. Edge 5xx now ~3.2%. We're still seeing sporadic 504s tied to a small subset of customers (customer ids in logs: cust_24*, cust_45*).

product-ops: Noting customers with active sessions; sending heads-up to CX Slack channel with ETA 15m for resolution.

pager-duty: Any sign this was caused by network flakiness or backend OOMs?

alex_m: Looking into backend instance metrics: mm-eu-west-1a host-host-07 shows CPU at 95% and swap thrashing around the time of cache invalidation. There's a backlog of pending connections. Likely momentary resource exhaustion from concurrent refetches.

sre-oncall: Decision: leave rate-limit and circuit-breaker in place. We're going to scale up model-manager pool by +2 instances in eu-west to absorb load and roll back the cache invalidation job if the scaling doesn't stabilize within 10m.

alex_m: Scaling up mm-eu-west group +2 nodes (autoscale override). Command: `infractl scale group mm-eu-west --add 2 --reason \"incident 4909998888\"`

deploy-bot: ACTION: infractl scale request accepted. Provisioning 2 instances; expected ready ~4-6m.

nina_r: Telemetry: after scale action, p95 backend latency dropped to 700ms and 5xx ratio at edge-a down to 0.9% in the last 2m. Good signal.

sre-oncall: Customer impact: degraded for ~11m in EU, focused on specific customers with long-lived sessions. Are we comfortable resolving pager?

pager-duty: I'll keep the pager until error rates are back to baseline for 15m. Oncall handoff to night-shift in 20m, I'll either hand off or escalate if any regressions.

product-ops: Sending status update to affected customer list: \"We experienced elevated errors in EU affecting chat and generation endpoints. We've throttled spike traffic, auto-failed unhealthy backends, and scaled capacity. Services are recovering; we will continue monitoring and follow up with root cause.\"

alex_m: Follow-up action items (owning):
- Create post-incident ticket: root cause likely cache invalidation + unbounded refetch fanout.
- Add guard to cache invalidation job to stagger invalidations per-edge (feature flag).
- Improve backend OOM detection + autoscale triggers.

nina_r: Also recommend adding a short-lived global knob to globally pause cache refetch on high 5xx signals.

sre-oncall: Agreed. For now, keep circuit-breaker open for 5m more, keep rate-limit at 10 rps for 10m, monitor. We'll close the incident after 30m steady baseline.

ops-bot: SYSTEM: Incident BOT: Status -> mitigated, monitoring. Severity downgraded to medium.

pager-duty: Closing note: Thanks team. Will prepare a short timeline and handover notes to the morning oncall.

product-ops: Thx all. I'll coordinate customer comms + postmortem request.

sre-oncall: Incident timeline: start 02:14:48Z; mitigation actions: rate-limit @02:16:10Z, circuit-breaker @02:17:05Z, scale +2 @02:18:30Z; primary recovery signal at 02:22:00Z.

pager-duty: Last check: 5xx back to 0.12% in eu-west for last 5m. Closing pager at 02:28:40Z.

sre-oncall: Thanks everyone. File postmortem ticket and assign to alex_m + nina_r.
